title: Nanoconfinement-enabled GO hydrogels via Hummers' method for real-time health monitoring
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,24406-24417
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01645F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Lili Tian, Zhiming Yang, Qin Wang
Graphene oxide (GO)-reinforced borate ester crosslinked hydrogels with self-healing and electric sensing properties were fabricated. The hydrogel exhibits high stretchability, strength, and fatigue resistance. It can serve as a flexible sensor for monitoring various human motions.
